Co-developed by Square Enix and Lancarse, Final Fantasy Resonance aims to bring SNES-era gameplay to modern systems merging pixel art and 3D in the established "2D-HD" format. And the good news is... it works. It works well. On all systems, no less. There's an image quality issue on Series S but otherwise, it's a win on all platforms. John explains.

After a visit to Infinity Ward's R&D Centre in Poland we have new intel on the COD Engine upgrades shipping in Modern Warfare 4. Newly-added ray-marched fog and smoke, overhauled weather systems, and a new material pipeline are the highlights. Plus we have a behind-the-scenes look at path tracing (unreleased to the public), in comparison to the shipped ray tracing mode and its rasterised settings.
